purpose: Eliminate the defect class 'fieldless catch-all error variant absorbs semantically distinct failure families' in callisto-graph's release executor, where GraphError::ReleaseIntentStale (E124) is constructed at 101 sites of which 6 are genuine staleness and 95 discard a typed model error, a subprocess exit status and stderr, a malformed-output detail, a merged-commit verification mismatch, a remote-object conflict, an unsupported feature, a precondition, or an internal invariant. The structural change makes staleness a proof-carrying variant constructible only by the fresh-re-observation code, gives every other family a typed variant so the source is carried by `?` rather than discarded by `map_err`, and closes the `map_err(|_ident| ...)` evasion of the workspace's existing `clippy::map_err_ignore = "deny"` with a source-scan architecture test.
scope: Structural boundary: the GraphError taxonomy in crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs and its three release-executor producers, crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/{release.rs, release_decision.rs, release_execution.rs}; the module-privacy boundary of crate::commands::release for StaleReason; the single subprocess exit-status classification point (run_checked) shared by release.rs and release_decision.rs; and crates/callisto-graph/tests/architecture.rs as the enforcement point. Consumers see the change only through the CLI JSON error envelope's code/message/help fields (crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs), which carry the new codes E158-E171 unchanged in shape.
non_goals: The post-dispatch npm registry-lag instance: already fixed as E157 RegistryPublishUnconfirmed (PR #78); this spec does not restate or alter it.
Patching any of the 95 individual sites in place without the taxonomy, StaleReason privacy, and architecture tests: per-instance patches are the failure mode this spec replaces.

The ~16 map_err(|_ident| ...) evasions outside the three release files (release_lock.rs, model/exec.rs, config/resolve.rs, moon/locator.rs, model/tag.rs, locate/ignore_walk.rs, commands/snapshot.rs, commands/publish.rs, cascade.rs, format/bump.rs, conventional/pre_cursor.rs, cli/commands/release_pr.rs): covered by the companion spec SPEC-ARCH-ERROR-SOURCE-PRESERVATION-GATE.json, which widens the architecture-test scope workspace-wide; not migrated here.
Changing CLI process exit codes, adding retry/backoff on ReleaseCommand or Registry errors, or changing the JSON envelope's shape.
Moving StaleReason or any new reason enum into callisto-model: they are graph-executor concepts with no serialized form.
Redesigning ReleaseStateError, ReleaseIntentError, or other callisto-model error enums: they are wrapped as-is.
Carrying GitCommitTrustEvidence or SourceIdentity payloads inside StaleReason: GitCommitTrustEvidence is not Clone and GraphError must remain Clone + Eq.
problem: GraphError::ReleaseIntentStale (crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs:233-238, code E124, help "Regenerate and reapprove the release intent; no release operation was authorized.") is a fieldless unit variant constructed at 101 production sites: 55 in commands/release.rs, 44 in commands/release_decision.rs, 2 in commands/release_execution.rs. Only 6 sites (release.rs recheck_trust, build_release_intent, validate_release_intent_with_state_directory, checked_git_remote) compare a fresh re-observation against the prepared one -- genuine staleness. The other 95 discard an already-typed cause: ReleaseIntentError/ReleaseOperationError/ReleaseDecisionError/ReleasePackageIdParseError from model constructors; RegistryError::{AuthFailed,RateLimited,Network,Other} from registry-output classifiers; non-zero subprocess exits with stderr discarded (git rev-parse/diff-tree/show/push, gh release create/api, npm view); malformed subprocess output framing (name-status, cat-file --batch, github api json); ~15 distinct merged-commit verification mismatches in derive_release_commit_decision (HEAD mismatch, decision file not written by this commit, no changeset consumed, changelog untouched, manifest version != claimed, unclaimed version change, claimed package unobserved); remote-state conflicts after an authorized effect (tag/forge release conflicts); mandatory-wildcard arms; and internal invariants. Two mechanisms make this the default path: the unit variant costs nothing to construct while every accurate variant requires fields, and the workspace's `clippy::map_err_ignore = "deny"` lint only matches the bare `|_|` closure spelling -- all discards in these files are spelled `map_err(|_error| ...)`, which evades it.
why_it_matters: The release path's own doc comments claim 'no release operation was authorized' -- E124's fixed help text. That claim is false for 95 of 101 paths that print it: an npm rate limit, an invalid registry token, a rejected git push, an unauthenticated gh CLI, a release PR whose committed decision disagrees with its diff, or a tag that already exists at a different commit all render identically and send the operator toward the wrong recovery (regenerate/reapprove the intent) instead of the actual next action (reconciliation, since durable state deliberately stays Attempting). This has already been fixed twice by adding a sibling variant (E136 ArtifactManifest, E157 RegistryPublishUnconfirmed) -- with a unit variant and an evadable lint, the next contributor extending the release path reintroduces the same defect with code that looks idiomatic for this file and passes `just lint`.
proposal: Three structural changes, sequenced across 4 independently-shippable PRs. (1) GraphError::ReleaseIntentStale becomes `{ reason: StaleReason }` (E124, help unchanged); StaleReason is defined in crate::commands::release with module-private constructors, making it a compile error for release_decision.rs/release_execution.rs to construct it at all. (2) Every discarded cause gets a typed home: `#[from]` passthroughs for ReleaseIntentError/ReleaseOperationError/ReleaseDecisionError/ReleaseInputSnapshotError/ReleasePackageIdParseError (E158-E162); `Registry{package,source}` E163; `ReleaseCommand{program,args,failure}` E164 fed by a single shared `run_checked` helper; `ReleaseCommitVerificationFailed{commit,reason}` E165 with one CommitVerificationFailure variant per distinct check; `ReleaseDecisionDecode` E166; `ReleaseRemoteConflict{conflict}` E167; `UnsupportedRelease{feature}` E168; `ReleaseSelectionInvalid{package,reason}` E169; `ReleasePreconditionUnmet{requirement}` E170; `ReleaseInvariant{detail}` E171. (3) An architecture-test enforcement layer in crates/callisto-graph/tests/architecture.rs: ReleaseIntentStale constructible only in the 4 allowlisted functions; StaleReason constructors never pub; zero map_err(|_ident|) in the three files; exit-status inspection confined to run_checked/observed_tag/npm_version_is_published; the substring 'reapprove' appears exactly once in error.rs. Migration uses a `#[deprecated] pub(crate) StaleReason::legacy_unclassified()` ratchet with per-file call-count pinning across PR1-PR4 so the count can only go down.
outcome: After PR4: ReleaseIntentStale is constructible at exactly 4 functions and nowhere else (compile error or failing architecture test otherwise); every release failure reaches the CLI JSON envelope with a code whose help text describes that specific failure -- a rejected git push reports E164 with program/argv/exit code/stderr, an expired npm token reports E163 wrapping RegistryError::AuthFailed, a release PR whose decision disagrees with its diff reports E165 naming the commit and mismatch, a pre-existing tag at a different commit reports E167 with both SHAs. `just lint` passes with no new `#[allow]`.
estimated_blast_radius: ~101 construction sites across 3 production files in callisto-graph, ~250 new lines in error.rs (+12 variants, +7 reason enums), 6 new architecture tests, 4 sequenced PRs each independently green under `just ci`. Not touched: callisto-cli command code (no downstream pattern-matches on ReleaseIntentStale exist outside these 3 files), callisto-model, docs. The E157 hotfix (PR #78) lands before PR1 and is untouched by this spec.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GraphError::ReleaseIntentStale is a struct variant `{ reason: StaleReason }` retaining code E124 and its existing help text. StaleReason's constructors (trust_evidence_changed, source_identity_changed, git_remote_changed, intent_differs_from_fresh_derivation) carry no pub/pub(crate)/pub(super) visibility, verified by a compile_fail doctest and an architecture test scanning commands/release.rs.

In production code, the token ReleaseIntentStale appears only in error.rs and, within release.rs, only inside recheck_trust/build_release_intent/validate_release_intent_with_state_directory/checked_git_remote. Enforced by architecture test release_intent_stale_is_constructed_only_by_fresh_reobservation.

Production code of the three release files contains zero matches of `map_err\(\|_[A-Za-z0-9_]*\|`. Enforced by architecture test release_modules_never_discard_error_sources, allowlist empty at PR4 completion.

GraphError gains #[from] variants ReleaseIntent/ReleaseOperation/ReleaseDecision/ReleaseInputSnapshot/ReleasePackageId (E158-E162) plus Registry{package,source} E163, each with #[source] and non-empty help; diagnostic-code uniqueness test passes with the new codes present.

A subprocess exiting non-zero on any release path yields ReleaseCommand{program,args,failure:NonZeroExit{exit_code,stderr}} E164 carrying the real program/argv/exit code/stderr; malformed output yields CommandFailure::MalformedOutput{detail}. Verified against git_stdout, parse_name_status, parse_github_api_response, and batch_manifest_blobs_at fixtures.
Exit-status inspection in the three release files occurs only inside run_checked, observed_tag, and npm_version_is_published. Enforced by architecture test exit_status_is_classified_in_one_place.

derive_release_commit_decision reports every verification mismatch as ReleaseCommitVerificationFailed{commit,reason} E165 with a distinct CommitVerificationFailure variant per check (HeadMismatch, DecisionNotWrittenByCommit, NoChangesetConsumed, ChangelogNotTouched, ManifestNotInDiff, ManifestVersionMismatch, UnclaimedVersionChange, ClaimedPackageNotObserved); help text never contains 'reapprove'.
A committed release-decision file that fails JSON parsing yields ReleaseDecisionDecode{path,message} E166, not ReleaseCommitVerificationFailed or ReleaseIntentStale.

Remote-object conflicts after an authorized effect yield ReleaseRemoteConflict{conflict} E167 (TagTargetDiffers/TagNotObservedAfterPush/ForgeReleaseDiffers/ForgeReleaseNotObservedAfterCreate/ForgeApiStatus); help text never contains 'no release operation was authorized'.

Mandatory wildcard arms yield UnsupportedRelease{feature} E168 (Ecosystem/SourceIdentity/BumpReason/PublishTarget); HermeticContent trust profile yields ReleaseIntent{source: UnsupportedTrustProfile} E158.

Duplicate/out-of-plan selections yield ReleaseSelectionInvalid{package,reason} E169 (Duplicate/NotInPlan/DuplicateRegistryTarget); a plan bump for an unknown package still returns the existing UnknownPackage E102.

Unmet preconditions yield ReleasePreconditionUnmet{requirement} E170 (DetachedHead/CanonicalRootMatchesWorkspace/GitRemotePrepared/GitHubRemote/ChangelogConfigured/ArtifactManifestProvided); an artifact-manifest validation failure still returns the existing ArtifactManifest E136 carrying ArtifactManifestError.

Internal-consistency failures (operation-order cycle, cascade via-lookup, unreachable match arms) yield ReleaseInvariant{detail} E171 whose help states this is an internal callisto failure to report, not an operator action.
The substring 'reapprove' occurs exactly once in error.rs, inside E124's help text. Enforced by architecture test reapprove_guidance_belongs_to_e124_only.

Migration ratchet: StaleReason::legacy_unclassified() is #[deprecated] pub(crate); per-file call counts are pinned exactly per PR (PR1: 49/44/2, PR2: 49/44/0, PR3: 49/0/0, PR4: 0/0/0) via an architecture test asserting equality, and the constructor is deleted entirely after PR4.

For every new variant (E158-E171), the CLI JSON envelope's format_error_json carries the matching code and a non-null help field, verified by one sample-construction test per variant in crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs.

suggested_pr_sequence: PR1: error.rs + architecture tests -- add all variants and reason enums, flip ReleaseIntentStale to { reason }, convert the 6 genuine sites, substitute legacy_unclassified() at the other 95, ratchet pinned at 49/44/2.
PR2: release_execution.rs (2 sites) -- E136 passthrough + ArtifactManifestProvided; ratchet 49/44/0.
PR3: release_decision.rs (44 sites) -- shared run_checked; E164/E165/E166/E169/E171; ratchet 49/0/0.
PR4: release.rs (49 sites) -- E163/E164/E167/E168/E170/E171, pure outcome functions for tag/forge/registry dispatch; ratchet 0/0/0; delete legacy_unclassified; map_err allowlist emptied.
